Anya (CSM): Heads-up — found an SLO acceptance gap for BrightCart during onboarding. Customer flagged slow responses and asked about credits.
Marco (Ops): Which SLO specifically? can you paste the numbers?
Anya (CSM): Uptime is fine, but p99 latency on gen endpoints is spiking. Quick snapshot:
```
metric: latency_p99
window: last 24h
value: 620ms
target: <=250ms
```
Riley (SRE): ack. I'll pull traces, but my gut says cache/warmup + batching mismatch. When did this start?
Anya (CSM): Started after their test load ramp two mornings ago, consistent during peak windows 11:00-12:30 PST.
Jade (BrightCart): Confirmed on our side — QA saw long tail latencies that block our go/no-go. We need an ETA and whether there's an SLA credit path.
Riley (SRE): Reproduced a high-p99 tail on a few request shapes. Short-term mitigation: enable prefix warmup and bump min-instances for the model pool. I'll prototype config change.
Marco (Ops): Cost note: raising min-instances to smooth p99 estimated ~+$3.2k/mo for their Dedicated pool. Will document alternatives.
Anya (CSM): For customer comms, propose: 1) acknowledge, 2) remediation plan + timeline, 3) provisional credit estimate, 4) invite joint postmortem. Thoughts?
SLA Bot: Auto credit calc: outage window: none; SLO breach: p99 latency > target for 7 days => provisional credit 0.75% of monthly usage => ~$450 (invoice INV-2026-04).
Anya (CSM): Good. Jade — would that provisional credit and plan be acceptable while we resolve? We can adjust after PM.
Jade (BrightCart): That would help. Want timeline though — is 48-72h realistic?
Riley (SRE): 48-72h is realistic for mitigation + validation. I'll post smoke test results here when done.
Marco (Ops): Ops will own the min-instance rollout and cost estimate. SRE will validate perf. Anya, can you draft the comms once Riley confirms?
Anya (CSM): Yep. I'll draft: short summary, mitigation steps, provisional credit, ETA 48-72h, and invite for a joint postmortem next week. Draft will be here for review.
Riley (SRE): Patch queued, running canary now. I'll post results and a command snippet for the rollout.
Marco (Ops): Also adding an internal runbook action: schedule a 15m warmup before peak and enable prefix cache for BrightCart's model. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slo-latency
Anya (CSM): Thanks team — goal: reassure customer and close onboarding without renewal risk. Will ping here once draft is ready. :thumbsup:
